title.description: The part, as the setup assistant names it ("Reading voice").

active.description: Whether a helper starting now loads the low-GPU set.

reason.description: Who it is on for ("gaming, GameMode"), null when off.

holders.description: The holders set with the CLI or the settings (not GameMode).

gameMode.description: GameMode as found at the last call start; null when not checked.

running.description: The models the running helper has: null when none runs.

pending.description: The running helper switches once the call or listening ends.

choices.description: The low-GPU set on this machine, as the setup assistant's options.

gpuBytes.description: GPU memory the set takes, as the catalog estimates it.

overrides.description: The parts set by hand (`low-gpu models`), the light tier for the rest.

path.description: Where the profile's state is kept.

error.description: Why the set could not be made: the full set is used.
